verdict.rationale: Wise Business can be driven headlessly through its own API: business payments via API, batch transfers, and webhook subscription management. A dedicated sandbox at api.wise-sandbox.com, plus a Simulation API, lets automated test flows run without touching production. Nothing documents a CLI or a CI-specific workflow, so headless/CI use rests on raw API integration alone. missing for 10: official CLI or headless tooling, documented CI/CD integration guidance (e.g. non-interactive auth for pipelines), a public OpenAPI spec for the main API (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
